content.title: About
content.content: Grits are a coarse cornmeal porridge available in regular and quick varieties. They are cooked with water and added fat, resulting in a creamy, hearty dish with a mild corn flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grits are a staple of the Southern United States, especially in Louisiana and Texas.
Quick‑cook grits are ready in 5‑7 minutes, while regular grits take about 20‑30 minutes.
Corn, the base of grits, is one of the oldest cultivated crops in human history.
Grits are often served with cheese, butter, bacon, or seafood.
In the U.S., grits are considered a signature dish of Southern cuisine.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Grits are rich in carbohydrates that provide quick energy, making them suitable for active lifestyles.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Cornmeal provides iron, essential for oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: Low sodium naturally
items.content: When prepared with plain water and no added salt, grits are naturally low in sodium.

items.title: Good source of fiber
items.content: Dietary fiber supports digestive health and promotes satiety.

items.title: Provides vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 aids protein metabolism and supports nervous system function.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to corn, experiencing skin or gastrointestinal reactions.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Grits can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Calorie content
items.content: Adding fat increases the calorie density, which may contribute to weight gain if consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot grits topped with butter, cheese, crispy bacon, a fried egg, or shrimp. They can also be used as a base for casseroles, added to soups, or made sweet with honey and berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep dry grits in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Cooked grits should be refrigerated and eaten within 3‑4 days, reheating before serving.

infant-formula-enfamil-prosobee-powder-m.title: Infant formula, Enfamil ProSobee, powder, made with bottled water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil ProSobee is a hypoallergenic infant formula powder designed for babies at risk of developing allergies. It contains easily digestible proteins, probiotics, DHA and ARA, and is fortified with vitamins and minerals. Preparation with bottled water adds an extra level of purity and safety.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: ProSobee was the first hypoallergenic formula in the Enfamil line to undergo clinical testing for reduced allergy risk.
The formula includes prebiotics and probiotics that support a healthy gut microbiome in infants.
It contains DHA and ARA – fatty acids essential for brain and eye development.
The product is free from soy, gluten, and lactose, making it suitable for sensitive infants.
Each container yields about 800 ml of prepared formula, convenient for long‑term use.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Probiotics and B‑vitamins help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA support normal neurological and visual development.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Hypoallergenic proteins and the absence of lactose reduce the risk of digestive discomfort and colic.

items.title: Healthy gut flora
items.content: Probiotics and prebiotics promote a balanced gut microbiota, important for nutrient absorption.

items.title: Mineral enrichment
items.content: The formula provides iron, calcium, and zinc, essential for bone growth and blood formation.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Although hypoallergenic, some infants may still react to trace milk proteins.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: A solution that is too concentrated can strain the kidneys; follow the manufacturer’s instructions.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Keep the opened container in a dry, cool place and use within 30 days.

items.title: Water temperature control
items.content: Water should be boiled and cooled to about 40 °C; water that is too hot destroys nutrients.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with 30 ml of boiled, then cooled (to 40 °C) bottled water. Stir thoroughly until the mixture is smooth, avoiding lumps.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in its original airtight container at 5 °C‑25 °C, protected from moisture and direct sunlight. Prepared formula should be used within 2 hours, and any leftover should be discarded.
